new_assertions.body: q_SigmaRFGH has 9,286 exact transporter-aware Q-F/Q-A/Q-V classes on complete 4x4-k4 and is the smallest tested valid transporter-aware Q-F carrier there.
A scalar invariant of a group action cannot choose among members of one orbit; X_h and p are therefore structurally incapable of serving as q_Sigma canonical tie-breakers.
The residual distinctions deleted by E1 but retained by RGH are semantically absorbed after F in every tested domain: F∘E1 and RFGH induce the same partition.
Exact normalized residual equality is stronger than rank-sufficient quotient equality; different residual normal forms may be lossless recodings of one future-sufficient partition.
The tested safe-forgetting kernel decomposes into a support-lattice ownership-feasibility component and a frontier/residual-interaction component; support algebra alone cannot subsume F.
The smallest-looking candidate by raw class count is irrelevant when it fails semantic sufficiency; minimality comparisons must be validity-first.
Geometry-specific Q-V success of residuals plus reduced support descriptors does not transfer across the complete holdouts and therefore cannot be promoted as a general value quotient.
